title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Investment in Mutual Funds
description: This course provides individuals with a comprehensive understanding of mutual funds, including their structure, benefits, risks, and investment strategies.
longDescription: Understand the nature of Mutual Funds from an investment perspective. Learn about Portfolio Evaluation. Learn about the work and role of Asset Management Companies. Understand the concept of Behavioural Finance. Understand the working of Stock Market Indexes. The aim of the course, Understanding Investment in Mutual Funds, is to provide individuals with a solid understanding of mutual funds and their role in building a diversified investment portfolio. The course emphasizes the importance of risk management and investment strategies in mutual fund investing. courseDetails: Understanding Investment in Mutual Funds is a self-paced online course that consists of video lectures, readings, and quizzes. The course covers a range of topics related to mutual funds, including their benefits, risks, investment strategies, and portfolio diversification. Participants will have access to course materials and can complete the course at their own pace.
